# Camp items that buff Luck and where to find them in Fallout 76

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Dec 26, 2023
- 3 min read

Updated: Feb 13, 2024

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_0ecaef5f60894deea5720b24118054c0~mv2.png)

The buffs you receive from these camp items will stack on top of buffs from food, chems, drinks, armour, etc.

You can not stack camp items that give the same buff ie Luck and Luck or Intelligence and Intelligence.

Camp item buffs will not stack on themselves.

__Bowling Alley Lane__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_b05439b24ced4acfa6eadff05f409a42~mv2.jpg)

Image credit: Mette & Cassi. Models: LadyBertilak254, ScarletR4v3n, ElPerro13521946 and SwingKid

**Buff:**

+2 Luck

+2 Charisma

**Lasts for:**

30 minutes

**Player animation:** 

Yes

**Obtained via:**

Atom Shop - 700 atoms

**Build Menu Location:**

Misc. Tab

**Build Limit:**

10 per camp, shelter, or workshop.

Shares a build limit with the Bowling Alley Lane and the American Bowling Alley Lane.

**Flamingo Units:**

1 Flamingo Unit
